name: tokendoctor
description: The same Claude Code for up to 40% less. See what your Claude Code use overpays, fix it, undo it any time. Runs on your machine.

slide.title: Slide the window instead of compacting
slide.description: Where Claude Code would summarize the conversation, elide old tool outputs instead (they can be read again): no summary request, every prompt and answer kept word for word. /compact still summarizes.

slideTo.title: Slide down to (% of where Claude Code compacts)
slideTo.description: How far a slide frees the context, as a percent of the point where Claude Code compacts (20 to 90). Lower leaves less behind and more turns before the next slide.
